intervention: H3: one noninteractive Light session restart from persisted messages after a recognized transient transport failure; subtract consumed iterations; keep command policy, schemas, prompts, argv improvement and admission unchanged

hypothesis.mechanism: Current noninteractive SDK sessions are destroyed on transport error and cannot use existing interactive send recovery. Rebuilding from persisted messages can complete the interrupted action without discarding prior progress.
hypothesis.primary: Audited instruction success separately in clean and controlled interruption strata; combined panel has a fixed 50% interruption weight and is not a population estimate.
hypothesis.secondary: Runtime success, recovery activation, duplicate mutations, conserved iteration budget; reconciled tokens/cost/time only at comparable audited quality.
hypothesis.risks: Replaying completed mutations, resetting budgets, losing usage/history, hiding permanent provider failures or cancellation.

taskSelection: Fixed before outcomes; these existing corpus tasks were not used in the preceding argv pilot or to choose H3. They are not claimed historically unseen.

fault.location: Three consecutive response bodies, starting at model request three, interrupted before bytes are delivered. SDK 0.0.82 retries at most three attempts before any model output; the injected burst exhausts that policy, then service recovers.
fault.interpretation: Controlled diagnostic intervention, not a real outage frequency estimate. Preserve charged/missing usage from the interrupted upstream request.

transport: Configured BLAME API/openai-codex; credentials never archived
environment: Same Linux x64 worker, installed pinned dependency tree, identical fresh fixture per paired task; no memory, solution retrieval or replacement trials; provider cache uncontrolled.

budget.policy: Fixed task and outer deadlines; preserve missing usage. SDK cost limits are post-request estimates and do not guarantee invoice caps. Stop starting further trials if observed reported cost reaches panel ceiling; keep planned but unexecuted trials visible.

ordering: Two conditions per task and repetition, reverse condition order in repetition two. Cyclic arm order by task, reverse arms and task order in repetition two. Sequential; no optional stopping for favorable results.
quality: Keep original functional scorer, original weighted score, runtime status, admitted verification and independently audited obligations separate. Audit all tool inputs and diffs; require requested post-edit build. No recovered reference solutions.
accounting: Reuse tested per-request/aggregate reconciliation. Missing usage from discarded upstream body remains missing, never zero. Costs SDK estimates; split clean/interrupted and preparation/runner/verification/outer elapsed time. No pooled historical totals.
decision: Retain H3 if controlled replays preserve safety and interrupted paired quality improves with no clean regression; claim only the measured panel/stratum. If clean global quality/efficiency fails to improve, continue with a separately preregistered single mechanism rather than resampling this panel.
interpretation: Separate known-task mechanism preflight using the real SDK/model; not confirmation or a replacement trial. Implementation may be repaired before the frozen panel starts.
